import html # Pre‑defined HTML template with placeholders. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}
{event_title}
Date: {event_date}
{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def create_event_invitation(e_title: str, e_description: str, e_date: str, e_notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML event invitation. Parameters ---------- e_title : str The title or heading of the event. e_description : str A detailed description of the event. May contain line breaks. e_date : str The scheduled date of the event. e_notes : str Any supplementary notes or instructions. Returns ------- str A safe, sanitized HTML string ready for rendering. """ # Escape all user supplied content to prevent XSS and ensure valid HTML. safe_title = html.escape(e_title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(e_description, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(e_date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(e_notes, quote=True) # Render the invitation using the template. invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes ) return invitation_html.strip()
